truths.truth: The shipped template writes no `stakes` at all, and a config copied from it still validates clean.
truths.evidence: `node -e "'stakes' in JSON.parse(...)"` over cadence-core/templates/config.json -> false; `grep -n stakes cadence-core/templates/config.json` -> exit 1, no match. `node cadence-core/bin/config.mjs validate --file cadence-core/templates/config.json` -> {"ok":true,"checked":46,"errors":[]}. `git diff --unified=0 5fc6c6c0~1..HEAD -- cadence-core/templates/config.json` shows exactly one removed line (`"stakes": "shipped",` at :3) and zero added lines, so nothing was deleted collaterally; the surviving key list is granularity,model,workflow,parallelization,git,planning,memory,review.

truths.truth: The whole init path a real project walks - template copy plus the forge writes both workflows make - leaves `stakes` unset, so the resolver rather than the file on disk decides the level. (The goal itself, traced from the init seam to the routing envelope.)
truths.evidence: Reproduced the shipped sequence in a scratch repo: `cp cadence-core/templates/config.json .planning/config.json` (new-project.md:56, adopt.md:41 are verbatim copies - `grep 'set stakes\|stakes=' ` in both files returns nothing, so neither writes the key), then `config.mjs set git.forge_provider=github` and `config.mjs set git.forge_repo=owner/repo` (both {"ok":true}). `'stakes' in config` is still false afterwards, and `route.mjs resolve --role cad-executor --phase 3` over that post-forge-write config returns {'ok':True,'stakes':'solo','stakes_set':False,'model':'sonnet'}. Wiring on the other side: seam-spawn-agent.md:242-243 and route.mjs:846/:1561 - `--phase` decides the floor's scope and the STATE cursor decides it when the flag is absent, and plan.md:102 / plan.md:382 pass `--phase {N}` explicitly.

truths.truth: Both floor arms are reachable from a repo built from the shipped template, shown from resolve output: clean plans discount to solo/sonnet, one unreadable plan fails closed at ok:true / shipped.
truths.evidence: Fixture = template copied to .planning/config.json, one plan declaring docs/README.md ('# Readme'), CADENCE_GLOBAL_CONFIG pointed at a missing path. Clean arm: {'ok':True,'stakes':'solo','stakes_set':False,'model':'sonnet','verify':'off','surfaces_answered':False}. Unreadable arm (PLAN-2.md created as a DIRECTORY): {'ok':True,'stakes':'shipped','stakes_set':False,'model':'opus'} with warnings ['risk floor: cannot read .../PLAN-2.md (not a regular file); no risk surface was computed from it']. The shipped test that pins this is route.test.mjs:1877 'template-initialised: a repo scaffolded from the SHIPPED template reaches both arms' - green in a 164/164 pass, 0 fail run of route.test.mjs. Pre-plan role also fails closed correctly: `resolve --role cad-planner --phase 4` on a fresh template project with no plans returns shipped/opus with reason 'no risk-floor computation: cad-planner is dispatched before a plan exists and reads none; the configured "shipped" stands'.

truths.truth: Set-ness is machine-checkable on the envelope, on both faces, and resolve and replay agree over the same config.
truths.evidence: resolve over a stakes-less template copy -> {'ok':True,'stakes':'shipped','stakes_set':False}; over the same file with stakes:'critical' -> {'stakes':'critical','stakes_set':True}. replay over the fixture repo unset -> {"ok":true,"stakes":"shipped","stakes_set":false,...}; with stakes:'solo' written -> {"ok":true,"stakes":"solo","stakes_set":true,...}. Traced end to end rather than re-derived: route.mjs:1386 and :1476 both emit `stakes_set: cfg.stakesSet`, the same flag readConfig maintains at :252 and the floor's discount predicate reads, so the reported set-ness and the routing it qualifies cannot drift. Held by route.test.mjs:733/:740 (resolve, both arms at the SAME level so only the flag separates them) and :2208 (replay, cross-checked against resolve off one config). NOTE on the contract: ROADMAP criterion 1 spells the observable `stakesSet`; CONTEXT D-04 deliberately renamed it to snake_case `stakes_set` on the envelope's own convention beside `surfaces_answered`, and the UAT items and CONTEXT AC2 use the new spelling. Substance met; the spelling deviation is a recorded decision, not a silent drop. No shipped surface consumes the field yet (grep shows route.mjs only) - D-04 scoped it to the envelope, so this is an observation, not a gap.

truths.truth: `config.mjs get stakes` distinguishes unset from configured, names route.mjs resolve as the seam that answers it, and the keyless read stays silent.
truths.evidence: Unset: {"ok":true,"values":{"stakes":"shipped"},"source":"global+repo","warnings":["stakes is unset: no config layer sets it, so the level is decided per phase from the plans in scope - `route.mjs resolve` answers it for a dispatch"]} - names both `stakes` and `route.mjs resolve`, and the value line still reports the schema default. Set (stakes:critical): {"ok":true,"values":{"stakes":"critical"},"source":"global+repo"} with no `warnings` key at all. Keyless `get --file <stakes-less config>`: 0 warnings, none mentioning stakes - checked on both a bare fixture and the full post-init config. Implementation at config.mjs:466 is gated on `keys.length && layered[k] === undefined && k === 'stakes'`, the same two gates the LEVEL_KEY arm uses, as a separate arm rather than a widened regex. config.test.mjs 102/102 pass, 0 fail, including the three new named arms.

truths.truth: Both init workflows state what is actually written, name both arms of unset, and sit AT (not over) their re-pinned byte ceilings.
truths.evidence: `grep -rn "shipped stakes" cadence-core/workflows/` -> exit 1, no match (repo-wide, the only survivors are .planning records D-09 leaves alone; no shipped doc - README.md, DESIGN.md, INTERNALS.md, config-catalog.md, config-reach.md - claims the template writes a level). Both files now carry, whitespace-normalised identically: "Config written with defaults (standard granularity, research and plan check off, verifier on). Stakes is left unset: it floors at solo when every plan in the phase reads clean, and at the shipped default when any of them cannot be read. /cad-config changes any of it." Both arms are true of the resolver, not just stated: truth 3 observed solo on clean plans and shipped on an unreadable one. Ceilings re-pinned to the MEASURED counts, not merely above them: weight.mjs reports new-project.md 26373 / adopt.md 21162 and weight-budgets.json now holds 26373 / 26373-row-equal and 21162, equal on both rows (wc -c agrees). Template row left at 1420 against a measured 1397 - it only shrank, which D-08 exempts. self-verify problems: [].

truths.truth: The README's adaptive-routing claim is held by a test that would RED on the pre-phase tree, and the four existing floor tests are unedited and green.
truths.evidence: prose-agreement.test.mjs 60/60 pass, 0 fail, including 'README: a template-initialised phase touching no surface really does route BELOW the default'. The arm reads the live README claim by substring, copies the SHIPPED template into a temp repo, resolves with --phase, and asserts route-table.json's stakes_order places the resolved level strictly below config.schema.json's keys.stakes.default - both figures read from artifacts, neither hardcoded. Falsified independently: restoring "stakes":"shipped" into a copy of the template and resolving the same clean-plan fixture returns {'ok':True,'stakes':'shipped','stakes_set':True}, which makes BOTH of that test's assertions fail - so the arm proves this phase and not the resolver. Floor tests: `git diff 5fc6c6c0~1..HEAD -- route.test.mjs` has no hunk touching them; they now sit at :1566 ('an explicit stakes=critical is never resolved below'), :1579 (unset -> solo), :1608 ('stakes=solo is a FLOOR'), :2258 (waived surface holds at the configured stakes), all green. The contradicting text is gone: route.test.mjs:1055's message is now 'the template writes no stakes, so the schema default stands', and `grep -rn "ships at shipped"` finds nothing.
